messages.subject: model hyperparameters
parts:
Hi INLA group,

I have Geostatistical data. I have set the model with more than one likelihood as follows:
formula<-y~0+z1+f(spa1,model=spde,group=spa1.group,
control.group=list(model='ar1'))+
z2+
f(spa2,model=spde,group=spa2.group,
control.group=list(model='ar1'))+
z3+
f(spa3,model=spde,group=spa3.group,
control.group=list(model='ar1'))+f(v,model="iid",
hyper = list(prec = list(initial = -5, fixed=TRUE)))

result <- inla(formula, data=inla.stack.data(stk), family=rep('poisson',3),
 control.predictor=list(A=inla.stack.A(stk),
                                    compute=TRUE),
control.inla = list(int.strategy = "eb", strategy = "gaussian"),verbose = T)

In "sommary(result)" everything is ok. But in " model hyperparameters", there is not "group rho" for ar1. I can't detect what's the problem.

Thanks in advance for your help and time.

Leyla
